dmrgateway-master.txt and mmdvmhost-dmrgateway.txt were captured on 2026-10-20 on
127.0.0.1 only. MMDVMHost 9384d68 ran with a fake modem over its UDP modem protocol,
DMRGateway ee79d38 linked to it, and DMRGateway logged into a fake master that
used the password passw0rd and sent the call back. The call is one superframe
on slot 2 from 3191868 to talkgroup 91. Each line is: time, direction, length,
packet in hex.

dmrgateway-master.txt: r>m is DMRGateway to the master, m>r the master to DMRGateway.
mmdvmhost-dmrgateway.txt: host>gw is MMDVMHost to DMRGateway, gw>host the reverse.
